name: wiki
title: 知识库 API
description: 知识空间、节点、空间成员管理

space_id.description: Wiki space ID <md-text type="field-name" >[How to get Wiki space ID](https://open.feishu.cn/document/ukTMukTMukTM/uUDN04SN0QjL1QDN/wiki-overview)</md-text>

lang.description: When querying My Document Library​​, specify the document library name display language to return

token.description: The wiki node or the actual token of the corresponding cloud document.;- Wiki node token: If the token in the URL link is preceded by "wiki", the token is the node token of the wiki.;- Actual cloud document token: If the token in the URL link is preceded by "docx", "base", "sheets", or other non-"wiki" types, it indicates that the token is the actual token of the current cloud document.; For more information, please refer to [Frequently Asked Questions about Documents - How to Retrieve Cloud Document Resource Tokens (IDs)](https://open.feishu.cn/document/ukTMukTMukTM/uczNzUjL3czM14yN3MTN).; Note: ;When querying with a cloud document token, you need to pass the corresponding document type into the `obj_type` parameter

obj_type.description: Document type, for shortcuts, this field is the obj_type of the corresponding entity

parent_node_token.description: Node's father token. If the node is at first level, this field is empty

origin_node_token.description: The entity node_token corresponding to the shortcut needs to pass this value when the node is created as a shortcut

origin_space_id.description: The space id of the entity corresponding to the shortcut

has_child.description: Whether this node has any child nodes

list.description: Get a list of Wiki spaces

page_token.description: Page identifier. It is not filled in the first request, indicating traversal from the beginning; when there will be more groups, the new page_token will be returned at the same time, and the next traversal can use the page_token to get more groups

need_notification.description: Whether to notify the other party after adding permissions

member_id.description: Member id, which should match the member type below

copy.description: Create a node copy in Wiki

target_parent_token.description: Target parent node token;- Target Wiki space ID and target parent token cannot be empty at the same time

target_space_id.description: Target Wiki space id;- Target Wiki space ID and target parent token cannot be empty at the same time

title.description: Copied new title. If blank, the new title is empty. If not, the original node title is used
